what: Pressing a question row opens the answer area from height 0 to full height in .4s power3.out while fading in (opacity 0→1). Pressing again folds it back to 0 over the same duration, fading out before closing — an FAQ and terms accordion where open items do not close each other.

options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ‹a,b,c,d›, default power3.out
options.[data-fx-part=head]: Row to press (child) — summary if details
options.is-opened: Marker attached to the element while open — the plus sign and arrow rotation are read by the consuming css
options.fade: false keeps opacity as is and changes only height — Brand accordion row
options.close-ease: Curve for collapsing only, same as the default ease — ease-in(0.42,0,1,1)
